S17.canonical_sql: WITH stage_order AS (SELECT DISTINCT stage_id, stage, CAST(SUBSTRING(stage_id, 8) AS INTEGER) AS stage_num FROM lever__opportunity_stage_history), stage_entries AS (SELECT stage_id, stage, opportunity_id, archive_reason, days_in_stage FROM lever__opportunity_stage_history), opp_max_stage /* For each opportunity, find the max stage_num they reached */ AS (SELECT opportunity_id, MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(stage_id, 8) AS INTEGER)) AS max_stage_num FROM lever__opportunity_stage_history GROUP BY opportunity_id), stage_stats /* Per stage: count entries, advanced, attrited, proceeding */ AS (SELECT e.stage_id, e.stage, CAST(SUBSTRING(e.stage_id, 8) AS INTEGER) AS stage_num, COUNT(DISTINCT e.opportunity_id) AS total_entries, ROUND(AVG(e.days_in_stage), 1) AS avg_days, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.max_stage_num > CAST(SUBSTRING(e.stage_id, 8) AS INTEGER) THEN e.opportunity_id END) AS advanced /* Count candidates who advanced (have a later stage) */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.max_stage_num = CAST(SUBSTRING(e.stage_id, 8) AS INTEGER) AND NOT e.archive_reason IN ('Advanced to next stage', 'Qualified', 'Proceeding', 'Hired') THEN e.opportunity_id END) AS attrited /* Count candidates who are at their terminal stage with a negative reason (attrition) */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.max_stage_num = CAST(SUBSTRING(e.stage_id, 8) AS INTEGER) AND e.archive_reason = 'Proceeding' THEN e.opportunity_id END) AS proceeding /* Count candidates still proceeding */, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.max_stage_num = CAST(SUBSTRING(e.stage_id, 8) AS INTEGER) AND e.archive_reason = 'Hired' THEN e.opportunity_id END) AS hired /* Count candidates hired at this stage */ FROM stage_entries AS e LEFT JOIN opp_max_stage AS o ON e.opportunity_id = o.opportunity_id GROUP BY e.stage_id, e.stage) SELECT stage_id, stage, total_entries, avg_days, advanced, attrited, proceeding, hired, ROUND(CAST(advanced AS REAL) / total_entries * 100, 1) AS pass_rate_pct, ROUND(CAST(attrited AS REAL) / total_entries * 100, 1) AS attrition_rate_pct, ROUND(CAST(advanced AS REAL) / NULLIF(total_entries - proceeding, 0) * 100, 1) AS resolved_pass_rate_pct, ROUND(CAST(attrited AS REAL) / NULLIF(total_entries - proceeding, 0) * 100, 1) AS resolved_attrition_rate_pct FROM stage_stats ORDER BY stage_num
